reputation_system.description: Tracks player standing with NPCs and factions. Affects prices, dialogue, and quest availability.

victor.name: Victor the Ranger
victor.description: The gruff ranger who watches over the forest paths

greetings.hostile: You. Get out of my sight.
greetings.friendly: Ah, good to see you. Need supplies?
greetings.honored: Friend! Come, let me show you what I've got.
greetings.exalted: My trusted companion! Anything you need, just ask.

bran.name: Bran the Innkeeper
bran.description: The warm, jolly innkeeper at The Prancing Pony

greetings.hostile: *frowns* I think you'd best find another tavern.
greetings.unfriendly: *polite but cold* What can I get you?
greetings.neutral: Welcome to The Prancing Pony! What'll it be?
greetings.friendly: Ah, welcome back, friend! Your usual spot's open!
greetings.honored: There's my favorite customer! First round's on me!
greetings.exalted: Family! Come in, come in! You're always welcome here!

elowen.name: Elowen the Enchantress
elowen.description: The mysterious enchantress in the tower

greetings.friendly: Ah, you again. *slight smile* What brings you to my tower?
greetings.honored: *genuine warmth* Welcome, friend. I've been expecting you.
greetings.exalted: My dear friend! *embraces you* Come, I have something special to show you.

greetings.hostile: Your coin's no good here. Leave.
greetings.unfriendly: *eyes you suspiciously* Cash only. No credit.
greetings.neutral: Welcome to my shop. Browse freely.
greetings.friendly: Ah, a valued customer! Let me show you the good stuff.
greetings.honored: My friend! I set aside some special items just for you!
greetings.exalted: Partner! Business has been good thanks to you. Anything you need!

garron.name: Garron the Forgemaster
garron.description: The armored blacksmith whose human mind lives on inside metal

greetings.hostile: *His helmet turns away* Leave my forge.
greetings.friendly: *sets down his hammer* Good to see you. Need something fixed?
greetings.honored: *his armor rumbles warmly* Friend. Come, let me show you what I've been working on.
greetings.exalted: *reaches out a massive hand* Family comes to the forge. What can I build for you?

aiko.name: Aiko Switchblade
aiko.description: The street-smart hustler of the Neon Underground

greetings.hostile: *hand moves to her blade* Wrong alley, choom.
greetings.unfriendly: *eyes you up and down* What do you want?
greetings.neutral: *leans on her stall* Looking to buy or sell?
greetings.friendly: *grins* Hey, it's my favorite customer! Got something special for you.
greetings.honored: *winks* There's my partner in crime! Come see what fell off a truck.
greetings.exalted: *genuine warmth breaks through* Hey... good to see you. Really.

cipher.name: Cipher Rue
cipher.description: The cybernetic bartender and dream dealer

greetings.hostile: *his cybernetic eye dims* Bar's closed. For you.
greetings.unfriendly: *polishes a glass without looking up* What'll it be?
greetings.neutral: *smirks* Welcome to the Lounge. What's your poison?
greetings.friendly: *leans in with a grin* There's my favorite regular. The usual?
greetings.honored: *his neural pathways pulse warmly* Gorgeous! Come sit close, I saved your spot.
greetings.exalted: *genuine affection in his voice* Hey you. Missed you around here.

lyra.name: Captain Lyra
lyra.description: The disgraced Fleet officer who commands the station

greetings.hostile: *cold professional stare* You're not authorized for this area.
greetings.unfriendly: *glances up from console* State your business.
greetings.friendly: *slight smile* Good to see you on deck. How can I help?
greetings.honored: *genuine warmth* Reliable as always. The station's lucky to have you.
greetings.exalted: *clasps your shoulder* I trust you with my ship. That says everything.

mara.name: Mara the Botanist
mara.description: The cheerful terraformer hiding deep trauma

greetings.hostile: *her smile falters* I... I don't think you should be here.
greetings.unfriendly: *fidgets with a leaf* Can I help you?
greetings.neutral: *waves cheerfully* Hi! Looking for something green?
greetings.friendly: *bounces excitedly* Oh! You're back! Come see what's blooming!
greetings.honored: *hugs you without hesitation* My favorite helper! The plants miss you!
greetings.exalted: *tears in her eyes* You're like family now. The garden knows your name.

takoda.name: Takoda the Firekeeper
takoda.description: The storyteller who trades tales for tales

greetings.hostile: *the fire dims* Your spirit brings cold. Leave this place.
greetings.unfriendly: *stirs the embers without looking up* The fire does not know you.
greetings.neutral: *gestures to a spot by the fire* Sit. Warm yourself.
greetings.friendly: *the fire brightens* Welcome back, traveler. The flames remember you.
greetings.honored: *warm smile* The fire has been waiting for you. Sit close.
greetings.exalted: *the flames dance* You carry stories now. You are one of us.

sheriff.name: Sheriff Gideon Blackwater
sheriff.description: The steadfast lawman with a past written in bounties

greetings.hostile: *hand rests on holster* You've worn out your welcome.
greetings.friendly: *nods with respect* Good to see law-abiding folk.
greetings.honored: *firm handshake* This town's better for having you.
greetings.exalted: *rare smile* Deputy in all but name. I trust you with this town.

miss_kitty.name: Miss Kitty
miss_kitty.description: The saloon owner who built a haven from nothing

greetings.hostile: *her warmth turns cold* I think you'd best find another establishment, sugar.
greetings.unfriendly: *polite but guarded* What can I get you?
greetings.neutral: *warm smile* Welcome to the Long Branch, darlin'!
greetings.friendly: *beams* There's my favorite customer! Your usual table's open!
greetings.honored: *takes your hands* Sugar, you're practically family now! First drink's on me!
greetings.exalted: *genuine tears of joy* Oh honey, I don't know what I'd do without you.

townspeople.name: Townspeople of the Realm
townspeople.description: General standing with the common folk

greetings.hostile: Guards! Keep an eye on that one!
greetings.friendly: *warm smiles and waves* Good day, adventurer!
greetings.honored: *people greet you by name* Hero! Good to see you!
*clasps your arm* Brother of the wild!
greetings.exalted: *bows head* Ranger-friend. The forest knows your name.

reputation_decay.note: Optional feature - reputation slowly returns to neutral if player is inactive

wolf_slayer.description: Awarded for completing Victor's Wolf Menace storyline

tavern_hero.description: Awarded for completing Bran's Tavern Troubles storyline

apprentice_mage.description: Awarded for completing Elowen's Arcane Mysteries storyline

friend_of_the_pony.name: Friend of the Pony
friend_of_the_pony.description: Awarded for completing Bran's Tavern Troubles storyline - you're family now!

fey_friend.description: Awarded for completing Elowen's Fey Mystery storyline - the fey remember your kindness
